mainEntity.name: What are the essential components of a functional outdoor kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: A functional outdoor kitchen typically includes key elements for cooking, preparation, and storage. Essential components often feature a built-in grill, sufficient counter space for food prep, and a sink with plumbing. Depending on your needs, a refrigerator, storage cabinets for utensils and dishes, and perhaps a side burner or pizza oven can also be integrated. Thoughtful layout and durable, weather-resistant materials are crucial for longevity and usability in the Los Angeles climate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Essential components for a functional outdoor kitchen include a built-in grill, counter space, a sink, and often a refrigerator and storage. Durable, weather-resistant materials are key for the Los Angeles environment.
